description: This file defines the 'ImportProductServices' class, which provides a service for importing product and inventory data from Excel spreadsheet files into the OFBiz system. It processes XLS files from a designated directory, reads product and inventory details, checks for existing products, and creates new product and inventory records in the database. It utilizes Apache POI for reading Excel files and interacts with OFBiz entities for persistence.

classes.name: ImportProductServices
classes.description: Contains the service method for importing product and inventory data from spreadsheets into the system.

methods.name: productImportFromSpreadsheet
methods.description: Reads XLS spreadsheet files from a designated directory, extracts product and inventory data, and stores new records into the database. Handles file reading, data parsing, duplicate checking, and posting to OFBiz entities.
